title: Crochet Heart Keychain
name: Heart Keychain
seoTitle: Easy Crochet Heart Keychain Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free, easy crochet heart keychain pattern: two flat hearts joined with a white picot border. Great for gifts and leftover yarn. Printable PDF download.
lead: Two flat hearts, worked in two rounds each and joined with a white border, so the keychain looks neat on both sides.
yarn: Cotton yarn in pink, dark pink and white

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in pink (hearts), dark pink and white (border)

rounds.text: Magic ring. ch 3, 3 tr, 4 dc, 1 tr, 4 dc, 3 tr, ch 3, sl st. Pull the ring closed.
2 sc in the ch-3 space, (3 dc in next st) x3, dc in next 4 sts, (dc, tr, dc) in next st, dc in next 4 sts, (3 dc in next st) x3, 2 sc in the ch-3 space, sl st.
On the front heart: (ch 2, 2 dc, ch 2, sl st) x2.
Hold both hearts together. Join white: ch 3, sl st, (ch 2, sl st in next st) x13, sl st, 2 sc, 2 sc, (ch 2, sl st in next st) x13, sl st. Fasten off.

finishing: Attach the keyring at the top.
